outputs.goal: Provide an HTTP service that turns long URLs into short, shareable links and redirects visitors from the short link to the original URL.

functional.text: Create a short link for a long URL. Optionally accept a custom alias.
Optionally accept an expiry; expired links must stop redirecting.
Visiting a short link redirects to the original URL.
Fetch metadata for a short link (original URL, created, expiry).

non_functional.text: Redirect path is latency-sensitive (target p99 < 50 ms in-process).
Only `http`/`https` URLs are accepted; reject obviously malicious or
Protect the create endpoint from abuse.
Runs locally with a single command; no external infrastructure.

ambiguities.question: Redirect status code (301 vs 302) not specified.
Behaviour when a custom alias is already taken.

decisions.topic: Redirect status code (301 vs 302) not specified.
decisions.rationale: keeps links expirable/deletable; 301 is cached by browsers

decisions.topic: Behaviour when a custom alias is already taken.
decisions.rationale: never silently reassign or overwrite a user's alias
